title: Celina Leão participates in motorcycle rally before first round
seoTitle: Celina Leão in motorcycle rally before election
subtitle: The Governor of the Federal District stood alongside Michelle Bolsonaro at an event gathering supporters of the former president
excerpt: On the eve of the first round of the election, Celina Leão attended the Freedom Motorcycle Rally alongside Michelle Bolsonaro in an act of gratitude and support.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the morning of Saturday, October 3, 2026, Celina Leão participated in an event that gathered supporters of Jair Bolsonaro one day before the first round of the election. The event, named “Freedom Motorcycle Rally”, was marked by expressions of gratitude and support for the former president, who is under house arrest.

Freedom motorcycle rally brings together Celina Leão and supporters

The gathering began at Granja do Torto, where supporters of Michelle Bolsonaro, Celina Leão, and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro had been present since 9 a.m. The trio left Granja at 10:50 a.m. to follow the motorcycle rally route, which was attended by other politicians, such as Senator Damares Alves and Senator Izalci Lucas.

Celina Leão thanks the public during the event

In a speech, Celina Leão described the campaign as “beautiful, purposeful, project-driven, and dedicated.” She emphasized her gratitude for the warm reception she received and stated that the motorcycle rally had a character of thanksgiving. Her speech was broadcast in a video circulated on the event's social media.

Michelle Bolsonaro and Celina Leão reinforce support for Jair Bolsonaro

Michelle Bolsonaro, former first lady and candidate for the Senate, stated that she believes “God's justice will come” and that the former president will “very soon” be alongside his supporters. She thanked Celina Leão and the public, highlighting the tribute to the captain, a reference to Jair Bolsonaro.

Electoral context of the Federal District

Celina Leão's participation in the motorcycle rally took place on the final day of campaigning before the first round, scheduled for Sunday, October 4. The event was one of the largest mobilizations of Jair Bolsonaro's supporters in the Federal District, coinciding with the presence of candidates for other offices, such as Leandro Grass, who held a car parade on the same day.

Repercussion of the event among DF candidates

While Celina Leão celebrated the campaign alongside Michelle Bolsonaro, the candidate for the government of the Federal District, Leandro Grass, made critical statements against the previous administration, mentioning “the corruption, the curse, the tragedy that was Celina's government.” The contrast in speeches highlights the fierce dispute between the main candidates in the federal capital.

With information from Poder360, Metrópoles.
